criteria.name: Hook strength
criteria.notes: First two lines name the load-bearing claim (Air Force readiness assertion) and signal the correction ('grades bidders on something else entirely') with no snark. Stands on its own near the 210-char cutoff.

criteria.name: Claim load-bearing + AK stakes
criteria.notes: Tied to an active DAF procurement with a June 29 2026 deadline and real capital-mispricing consequences for defense contractors and allocators bidding the Alaska AI data center RLP. Named agency, program, deadline.

criteria.name: Steelman fairness
criteria.notes: P3 is generous and accurate: grants that defense real-estate leasing generates readiness-budget revenue and that dual-use co-location has theoretical defense value. Matches dossier steelman. No snark.

criteria.name: Counter-evidence quality
criteria.notes: Rebuttal quotes the RLP evaluation criteria accurately and traces to claim_dossier.json. A single outlet (Alaska's News Source) reports the RLP contents; no second independent outlet or direct SAM.gov/federal-docket link in the dossier.

criteria.name: Factual density
criteria.notes: Named specifics in nearly every sentence: Moriarty's title, June 9 pub date, RLP quoted verbatim, energy/water/bandwidth criteria, June 29 2026 deadline.

criteria.name: Source quality
criteria.notes: Claim attribution is clearly primary (named senior DoD official, first-person statement, live URL). Counter-evidence shares the same single-outlet concern as Counter-evidence quality. Both sides pass the 7-descriptor but not the 10.

criteria.name: Voice match
criteria.notes: Analytical, structural, business-literate throughout. 'So price it accordingly' and 'a bet on a scoring criterion that isn't written down' are sharp. One slight transitional line before the bullets keeps it from a clean 10. No contempt or dunking.

criteria.name: Readability (LinkedIn)
criteria.notes: Tight 2-4 sentence paragraphs, one 4-item bullet block, ~441 words, well under 3000 chars. Easy to scan.

criteria.name: Engagement question
criteria.notes: Real, debatable industry question tied to the corrected frame. No follow-us CTA, no rhetorical softener.

criteria.name: Business actionability
criteria.notes: Reader can name the exact decision to reframe: do not pay a defense-mission premium bidding the DAF Alaska AI data center RLP; compete on energy, water, bandwidth mitigation. Deadline June 29 2026.

hard_fails.name: hashtag_count_in_range
hard_fails.note: 5 hashtags at end only, all on the brand.yaml whitelist.

hard_fails.name: punctuation_bans_held
hard_fails.note: No em-dashes, en-dashes, double-hyphens, colons, or semicolons in body.

hard_fails.name: claim_is_attributed
hard_fails.note: Names Robert Moriarty and quotes his verbatim claim; traces to claim_dossier.json.

hard_fails.name: steelman_present
hard_fails.note: P3 states the strongest honest version before any rebuttal, consistent with the dossier steelman.

one_sentence_fix: Add a direct SAM.gov or federal-docket link to the RLP (or a second independent outlet) so counter-evidence meets the primary-source or dual-outlet standard and lifts both Counter-evidence and Source quality to 10.
